thread:
customer-mark: Hey team, after migrating some services to the new Go SDK (v0.9.0) our embeddings endpoint started returning 422 errors sporadically: "dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 3072". We send batches of 128 items (we were previously at 32). This started after we turned on streaming+auto-batch. Any ideas?

Nina Support: Sorry about that, Mark. Can you confirm which model you're requesting and whether different services share the same API key? Also paste the exact request body if possible.

customer-mark: Model: text-embed-alpha-001. We do share keys across a few microservices (A/B testing with a smaller internal variant that returns 3072-dim). Request body is standard: {"model":"text-embed-alpha-001","input": [..128 strings..]}. We rely on the SDK's auto-batching.

Owen DevX: Flagging a known issue: Go SDK v0.9.0 had a regression in the streaming assembler when auto-batch > 64. It didn't namespace partial vectors by in-flight request id under high concurrency, so fragments from concurrent responses could be concatenated. That yields 2x vectors in some cases (hence 1536->3072).

Priya Eng: Couple of quick checks for your side: 1) Are you using a shared persistent HTTP2/keepalive connection? 2) Do you have client-side retries enabled (the SDK default retrier might re-send partial requests on 429)? If retries combine with streaming it can produce duplicate parts.

customer-mark: We do use a connection pool and the default retry policy. We observed the failures mostly during traffic spikes where we hit 429s and some 504s.

Nina Support: For an immediate workaround try these: 
- Temporarily set maxBatchSize: 32 (or lower) in the Go client config.
- Disable streaming at the client if you can: stream: false. That will force a single response per request.
- Pin the SDK to v0.8.7 which predates the streaming assembler change.

customer-mark: Can you share the exact config flags? We're in k8s and update cycles are a bit slow.

Owen DevX: Example Go config snippets:
```go
client, _ := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{
  APIKey: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"),
  AutoBatch: true,
  MaxBatchSize: 32, // temp workaround
  StreamResponses: false, // disable streaming until patch
  RetryPolicy: redwood.RetryPolicy{MaxRetries: 2, Backoff: time.Second},
})
```
Also set Env var REDWOOD_SDK_LOG=debug to capture `part-id` events.

SRE-Bot: Note: when troubleshooting, capture headers x-request-id and x-redwood-stream-id from the failed response. Those map to our trace logs.

customer-mark: Attaching one failed response headers (redacted) and a small HAR extract:
```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: rx-abc123
x-redwood-stream-id: rs-2022-77

{"error":"dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 3072","expected_dim":1536,"received_dim":3072}
```

Owen DevX: Thanks, that stream-id shows two partial streams merged. We have a patch (PR 4101) that ensures the streaming assembler keys partial chunks by request id and model signature. We're cutting v0.9.1 with backports to the 0.9.x line.

Nina Support: Timeline? Customers asking for ETA.

Priya Eng: Patch merged to main at 1789123500 and packaged as v0.9.1. Publish to our Go registry in ~10m. We'll also add a server-side guard that validates final vector length per-request and returns a clearer error with both dims and a trace link.

Owen DevX: Additionally recommend app-level retry changes: reduce max retries to 1 for streaming endpoints and add jitter. If you must retry, disable streaming before retrying to avoid concatenation of partials.

customer-mark: Could this affect Python/TS SDKs too? We have some services in TS.

Owen DevX: We audited recent client releases: TS v1.2.3 had a similar but rarer bug; Python v1.2.2 was fine. We're issuing cross-SDK patch releases where necessary.

customer-mark: I'll switch rollout to pin code to v0.9.1 once published and lower batch size in the meantime. Any logs I should send you?

SRE-Bot: If you can, gather the following: request body, response body, all response headers, SDK debug log with part-id events, and server trace id (x-redwood-stream-id). Upload to the ticket.

Nina Support: I'll open ticket #99012 and tag eng to accelerate. Also adding KB entry for "embeddings dimension mismatch / streaming + auto-batch" with steps to reproduce, collect traces, and mitigations.

customer-mark: Quick question: will server-side fallback prevent this from happening again if two model variants are used concurrently behind the same key?

Priya Eng: We will add per-connection isolation and stricter checks. But client-side fixes are critical: never rely on the SDK to demultiplex partials if you run mixed-model A/B on the same connection. Best practice: use distinct API keys or distinct client instances per model variant.

customer-mark: Got it. Thanks. We'll apply the workaround and wait for v0.9.1.

Owen DevX: Patch published to registry (v0.9.1) at 1789123515. Please upgrade and re-enable your original batch sizes.

customer-mark: Upgraded and re-enabled streaming/128 batch. Running load tests now. Will post results in 2h.

Nina Support: Thanks Mark. We'll keep the ticket open until you confirm stability. If you hit recurrence include the x-redwood-stream-id and logs.

customer-mark: Quick follow-up after 2h load: 0 dimension errors across ~10k requests. Happy to close once we run for 24h.

support-triage: Marking as `monitoring` and will auto-close after 24h of no regressions.
